description.narrative:
Stakeholder effects: - Increase in accessibility of finance for Women-inclusive Enterprises (WiEs): IFC anticipates that the Project will support TSKB to increase access to finance for WiEs which are operating in Türkiye (women-inclusive mid-caps) that meet certain gender equality criteria. TSKB aims to allocate the funds to finance WiEs that have been affected directly or indirectly by the February 6th, 2023 earthquake in Türkiye or for lending specifically targeted towards earthquake-affected areas on a best effort basis.
- Improved outcomes for women employees of borrowing WiEs: IFC anticipates that the Project will support TSKBs WiEs to support women employment and/or improve the gender score, whichever is applicable.
Contribution to Market Creation : Inclusiveness. The investment will promote awareness of the mid-caps on creating gender inclusive workplace in the market and support TSKBs gender finance efforts in Türkiye. The proposed financing will build upon IFCs efforts in developing such priorities in Türkiye.

The proposed senior loan of up to US$100 million to Turkiye Sinai Kalkinma Bankasi A.S. (TSKB, or the Bank) aims to provide access to finance to Women-inclusive Enterprises (WiEs), which are private sector mid-cap companies in Türkiye that meet certain gender equality criteria.
